features.name: Skene Parish Church, Kirkton Of Skene
features.fullDescription: William and Andrew Clerk (?) 1801. Gothick. Rectangular plan, harled with margins piend roof; original glazing; 2-window E. and W. with centre circular window and doorway; W. frontage has superior finish with pilastered centre mullions. 4-window S. frontage, centre w slightly advanced with gable quatrefoil and bellcote dating from repairs of 1840, John Smith, architect. Session room dated 1884 in style of original. Interior: originally U-plan with central pulpit. Remodelled with W. gallery (original R-doric columns and gallery front re-used) G. Bennet Mitchell 1932. Wood ceiling with cavetto cornice. Mowat Bell 1735.

features.name: Churchyard, Skene Parish Church, Kirkton Of Skene
features.fullDescription: Rubble-walled enclosure; no old stones of special note, fontbowl and mortsafe at Church door; late scots gothic arch and tomb chest monument to McCombies of Easter Skene and Lynturk, red granite 1890.

features.name: Kirkstane House, Manse Road, Kirkton Of Skene
features.fullDescription: Rear part 1779, front part and complete remodelling John Smith 1840 2-storey harled with margins, 1840 part crow stepped; 3-windows front, centre bay advanced with round headed doorpiece with plain stepped hood-mould. Addition (Clyne 1878) lately removed and building renovated. Block of offices.

features.name: Kirkton House, Kirkton Of Skene
features.fullDescription: John Smith dated J.K. I.P. 1825. N. part J. and W. Smith 1848. Renovated 1924. Neo-Greek, single-storey and full basement with broad eaves; rough ashlar, basement bull-faced. Tetra-style wood Greek doric portico centre E. front; canted bay centre S. front; twin bows W. front.
